manual.memory_scope: This route's main-process PyTorch CUDA allocated-byte peak, reset after its warmup. Baseline includes the fixed Q/K/V, upstream gradient and any resident allocations. Forward+backward includes the autograd graph, saved tensors, temporaries and Q/K/V gradients; forward-only uses no_grad. Excludes fixture creation/transfer, correctness checks, profiler, reserved-but-unused allocator memory and CUDA driver allocations. No optimizer or model parameters.
